Feature engineering is the process of selecting and transforming raw data into a set of features that can be used as inputs for machine learning models. The goal of feature engineering is to create a new set of features that better represent the underlying data and relationships, in order to improve the performance of the machine learning model.

Feature engineering often involves selecting and transforming a combination of numerical, categorical, and text data, and can include techniques such as feature scaling, one-hot encoding, dimensionality reduction, and feature extraction. The process of feature engineering can be time-consuming and requires a thorough understanding of the data and the problem being solved, as well as the ability to creatively translate the raw data into a suitable representation for the machine learning model.

Effective feature engineering can significantly improve the accuracy and reliability of machine learning models across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, finance, and marketing, among others.
